language.title: Language
language.desc: The interface language. Auto matches your browser language, then your time zone, and falls back to English.

start.title: Open on start
start.desc: The platform the WebUI opens to: where you left off, or a fixed platform.

sort.title: Default sort
sort.desc: Sort order when entering a platform; falls back to “Relevant”.

type.title: Default type
type.desc: Show only videos, only images, or everything when entering a platform.

pageSize.title: Items per page
pageSize.desc: How many items each request fetches. More is slower and more likely to trigger platform rate limits.

dialog.title: Settings
dialog.hint: Settings are saved in this browser and don't sync to others.

theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: With “System”, follows your system's dark mode in real time.

density.title: Card density
density.desc: Column width of the grid: Compact fits more cards, Cozy shows larger covers.

stats.title: Show engagement
stats.desc: Likes, comments and views on cards.

pixel.title: Background & wave effects
pixel.desc: Pixel blocks behind the page: they light up near the cursor, and a wave sweeps from top right to bottom left on clicks and while loading.

motion.title: Reduce motion
motion.desc: With “Always”, only simple fades are used regardless of system settings.

experimental.note: These features are experimental. Their behavior and location may change.

rawJson.title: Show raw JSON
rawJson.desc: Adds a {'{}'} button to the detail card's title bar that switches to the raw object returned by the platform (--raw), handy for checking fields.

hoverPreview.title: Video preview on hover
hoverPreview.desc: Hover over a video card and it lifts, grows to the video's shape and plays muted. If the list has no video URL, details are fetched once.

server.title: Server settings
server.hint: Saved in catbus on this machine and applied to all browsers; the command line uses the proxy too. Downloaded files are saved by the browser, at its download location.
server.demo: Demo mode doesn't connect to catbus, so server settings can't be read or changed.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.desc: Global proxy catbus uses to reach platforms ({key} in config.toml). Supports http, https, socks4, socks5 and socks5h; leave empty for no proxy.
proxy.platforms: Platform proxies (override the global proxy; read-only, change with {command})
